About

Twelve years old,
first folding boat.

I’ve had folding boats since I was twelve. Last summer I paddled a 1950s folding kayak 2,580 km down the Danube, from Ulm to the Black Sea, with my dog Fluffo as crew.

I trained as an architect at the TU München, I work as a model, and I’ve spent years in product photography. On every journey I shoot with the best camera gear I can carry. The camera is how I bring the journey home.

Five languages. A lifetime of racing and paddling the coasts of southern Spain, Corsica and the Mediterranean.

— Tassilo

The camera is how I bring the journey home.

Expeditions 2026

Two journeys, one rule:
no engines.

01

Spain, under human power

Two months crossing Spain on foot, by kayak and on horseback. The desert of Almería, the high plains of Castilla, the wet green north coast — sleeping outside the whole way.

From 30 July Two months · Foot / kayak / horse

02

A lap of the Balearics, filmed

Around Mallorca and Menorca by small boat — some 250 nautical miles with Fluffo aboard. A short documentary, daily films, and a body of photography.

September ~250 nautical miles · With Fluffo
